description:
**Landis\+Gyr EMEA** 
 , formerly part of the Landis\+Gyr Group, supports electricity, gas, water and thermal utilities in managing increasingly complex networks, improving operational efficiency and enabling more sustainable use of resources.
   

  

  

  

 With more than
 **2\.800 employees in 19 countries** 
 and decades of experience in critical infrastructure technology, the company provides advanced metering, network intelligence and digital solutions to utilities and infrastructure operators primarily across Europe, Middle East and Africa. As a standalone organisation, Landis\+Gyr EMEA builds on long\-standing customer relationships and proven technology capabilities, backed by experienced regional teams.
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 The Security Testing Engineer (Software \& Cloud) ensures that Landis\+Gyr’s EMEA software and cloud\-based solutions are secure, compliant, and resilient. This role focuses on identifying, reproducing, and verifying vulnerabilities across SaaS platforms, backend APIs, web applications, and cloud infrastructure, while working closely with DevSecOps and R\&D teams to integrate testing into the CI/CD process.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Plan, execute, and document application and cloud security tests, including API, web, and service\-level penetration tests.
* Validate the effectiveness of SAST, DAST, and container scanning in CI/CD pipelines and ensure detected issues are triaged and resolved.
* Assess authentication, authorization, and session management mechanisms in web and mobile applications.
* Review cloud configurations and deployments (e.g., GCP, etc.) for compliance with best practices and internal security baselines.
* Simulate attack scenarios to evaluate resilience of multi\-tenant cloud services and identify weak points in integration layers.
* Work with R\&D to define secure deployment and monitoring controls for production environments.
* Provide remediation guidance to development teams and verify fixes through structured retesting.
* Support audits and certifications (e.g., CSTAR, ISO 27017, IEC 62443, CRA) with test evidence and reports.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 4\+ years of experience in application or cloud security testing, ideally in SaaS or industrial/energy environments.
* Deep knowledge of OWASP Top 10, API Security Top 10, and modern cloud security risks.
* Solid understanding of cloud platforms (e.g., GCP), including IAM, networking, and policy enforcement.
* Ability to chain low\-severity findings into meaningful attack paths

description:

 The candidate will be responsible for the engineering, implementation, validation and life cycle management of FACTS/STATCOM Projects. The role requires strong expertise in Industrial Control System, operation technology cybersecurity, ensuring compliance with customer specifications and international standards such as IEC 62243, IEC 62351, NERC CIP, and ISO 27001\. The candidate will work closely with control, protection, SCADA, networking, and commissioning teams to deliver secure and reliable power system. Experience of working in 1 – 2 STATCOM/HVDC/Power Plant project will be preferred.
   

  

**Job Description**
 GE Vernova delivers reactive power compensators such as Static Synchronous Compensators (STATCOM) and Static Var Compensators (SVC), on which we are the global FACTS Solution Line based in Finland, India, Brazil and US. These systems are used to control power system voltage and reactive power flow as well as to improve the power system stability and transmission system efficiency. Via our projects, you truly have a chance to make the world a better place by helping our global customers in saving vital energy and securing stable electricity distribution.
   

  

 We are looking for Engineering Professionals to join the FACTS Solution Line team. The position will be based in Noida, India with hybrid working flexibility. You will be working on cutting edge technology and varied international high\-profile projects. In this position, you will be reporting to Engineering Manager – Secondary Engineering, Noida office and it can be considered a top priority position to perform in a critical engineering discipline for overall FACTS business.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop cyber security architecture for EHV/Substation and FACTS Projects.
* Prepare cyber security design documents, security architecture, hardening guidelines, and implementation procedures.
* Perform security risk assessments, threat modelling, and vulnerability analysis for OT/ICS environments.
* Configure and implement firewalls, managed switches, VLANs, VPNs, security gateways, and secure remote access solutions.
* Develop secure network architecture for SCADA, HMI, Engineering Workstations, RTUs, Gateways, and Protection IEDs.
* Implement device hardening, user access management, password policies, antivirus, application whitelisting, patch management, and endpoint protection.
* Ensure compliance with IEC 62443, IEC 62351, ISO 27001, NERC CIP, customer cyber security specifications, and utility requirements.
* Good understanding of IEC 61850\-based Substation Automation Systems.
* Support FAT, SAT, cyber security testing, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and security audits.
* Coordinate with customers, consultants, OEMs, and third\-party cyber security agencies during project execution.
* Configure and support DMZ infrastructure, including Active Directory, syslog servers, and jump servers. Manage and maintain firewalls, including rule configuration, access control, and network segmentation. Support secure network architecture for critical power and automation systems.
* Experience with DMZ infrastructure, Active Directory, syslog servers, and jump servers
* Familiarity with vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and compliance checks.


**Required Technical Skills**

* IEC 62443, IEC 62351, ISO 27001, NERC CIP
* Substation Automation Systems (SAS)
* SCADA, HMI, RTU, Gateway, Protection Relays
* Industrial Ethernet Networks and Managed Switches
* Firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, Hirschmann, Moxa, etc.)
* VLAN, VPN, Routing, Network Segmentation
* Windows \& Linux Server Hardening
* Active Directory and Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC)
* Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing
* Security Event Logging and Monitoring
* Antivirus, Endpoint Protection, Patch Management
